data.what_it_does: Provides the Android platform implementation for the stripe_platform_interface package, allowing Android-specific Stripe features. It is meant to be used automatically as an endorsed implementation via the flutter_stripe plugin.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app targeting Android using the flutter_stripe plugin.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android without using the main flutter_stripe wrapper.
You are not using Stripe for payments.
strengths: Endorsed implementation for Android automatically added by flutter_stripe.
Synchronized with Stripe React Native updates.
weaknesses: Not intended for direct standalone usage without flutter_stripe or stripe_platform_interface.
data.setup_notes: Automatically added to your dependencies by adding the flutter_stripe package to your pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Main overarching package that automatically includes this android platform implementation.
